cohort: The study included 102,683 babies birthed by 99,467 women, including singletons, twins, triplets, and quadruplets, at a perinatal tertiary referral network.
finding: The study found that high-risk pregnancy is common in India, with 75.18% of women categorized as high-risk by birth, and diabetes, thyroid disorders, and hypertension being the most common comorbidities.
mod_finding: Lower segment caesarean section was the most common mode of birth (50%), followed by spontaneous vaginal birth (39.68%) and assisted vaginal birth (9.88%).
